subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR6: 'If record-name-1 is specified, identifier-1 or literal-1 shall be valid as a sending operand in a MOVE statement specifying record-name-1 as the receiving operand.' (--check OK). BindFromPhrase ends in BindMoveOf(source, [record], phrase) - the MOVE statement's own screen, with the phrase named in every message. Probes: index item sender -> COBOL0809 (ws3snd2); national function to alphanumeric record -> 0819 (ws3fnatof); SPACE to a numeric record at 2023 -> 0902 (the edition-dependent Table 16 cell, ws3snd5); alphanumeric literal, numeric-edited item and 3.5 to PIC 9(5) accepted, all legal MOVEs (ws3snd1/3/4). Both arms (sequential and keyed) call the same helper. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (base WRITE statement; the 2023 text records no change to this rule in Annex E)]
